messages:
Renee CSM: Heads-up — NomadHealth onboarding shows rising p95 during bulk note-generation jobs. Renewal call in 6 days and account owner flagged latency as a churn risk. I want to propose a contained perf experiment: route short note requests to a compact int8 model, enable prefix KV caching for session flows, and apply a shallow model-mix for ambiguous prompts (fallback to std for safety). Can we run a tightly-scoped canary + a lightweight eval?

Omar Eng: Agree. We have redwood/note-lite-int8 ready. For model-mix, we can set routing weights so only 10% of borderline requests hit the compact model during the ramp. Also suggest reducing max_batch_delay to 15ms for the dedicated pool to blunt tail queues. I'll craft the route and canary command.

Lina ML: Quality caveats: abstractive condensation sometimes loses key entities when aggressively quantized. Recommend a 100-sample golden set (anonymized) and a simple entity-presence check plus summary-length delta. If entity recall drops >1.5% we'll abort. Also log hallucination heuristics.

Fergus Platform: Rollout plan: staging smoke -> 2% canary for 60 minutes -> 8% for 3 hours -> 40% overnight -> evaluate and full. Success gates: p95 <= baseline + 12ms, p99 not regressing, error-rate <= +0.4% absolute, entity-recall drop <= 1.5%. I'll reserve a 1-GPU slice and freeze burst autoscale. Canary alerts will post to #renewals.

Renee CSM: Can I get a one-paragraph customer blurb I can share before the renewal? Keep it reassuring and non-technical.

Omar Eng: Customer blurb: "We're running a brief performance test to speed up short note generation by routing select requests to a compact model. We'll monitor quality closely and can rollback instantly. Expected improvement: ~20-30% reduction in p95 for short requests."

CanaryBot: Scheduled canary: NomadHealth /generate-note at 2026-11-02T15:00Z (2% traffic, 60m). Monitoring: perf-alerts + eval-harness.

Lina ML: I'll trigger the eval harness at canary start and post a short report. Fail if entity recall drops >1.5% or hallucination heuristic doubles. Will also sample 15 outputs for manual review.

Omar Eng: Routing snippet (console-ready):

```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"name": "short-notes", "match": "input_tokens <= 110", "model": "redwood/note-lite-int8", "weight": 1},
    {"name": "long-notes", "match": "input_tokens > 110", "model": "redwood/note-std", "weight": 1},
    {"name": "edge-mix", "match": "confidence < 0.6", "model": "redwood/note-std", "weight": 9}
  ],
  "canary": {"percent": 2, "duration_minutes": 60}
}
```

Rollback CLI: `rwctl routes rollback nomad-note-route --to previous`

Fergus Platform: I've reserved the slice and will post the dashboard link at canary start. Owners: Omar (deploy/rollback), Lina (quality), Renee (customer comms). CanaryBot: notify #renewals if any gate is breached.

Renee CSM: Thanks all — dropping the blurb into the renewal collateral now. Please tag me when canary is green so I can update the account team before the meeting.

Omar Eng: Will do. Short note posted above.

Lina ML: Eval template link: https://redwood.console/evals/nomad/note-lite (results after canary).

CanaryBot: Canary started. Monitoring live.

Renee CSM: Tagging the account owner now. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:

-- thread end --
